newsitem.title: USA: Pegasus to buy four DIRECTV franchisees.
newsitem.headline: Pegasus to buy four DIRECTV franchisees.

text.p: Pegasus Communications Corp. said Monday it has signed letters of intent to acquire four DIRECTV franchisees serving about 19,000 customers for $31.8 million in cash and $8.6 million in stock.
The franchisees operate like cable television companies but provide programmes beamed from a satellite to an 18-inch dish owned by a consumer.

Pegasus said the franchisees serve customers in Arkansas, Indiana, Mississippi, Virginia and West Virginia. The acquired territories comprise about 365,000 television households and 40,000 business locations.

The Radnor, Pa.-based company said the acquisitions will increase its total DIRECTV territory to about 1.4 million television households and 120,000 business locations serving about 46,000 subscribers.
Pegasus is the largest independent provider of DIRECTV services and also operates cable systems in Puerto Rico and New England.
Its stock rose $1 to $13.75 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
